title: Adding like fractions: the bottom number names the piece size
skill: Add two fractions with the same denominator: add the numerators, keep the denominator.

knowledge: a/n is a pieces of size 1/n
equal pieces of the same whole can be counted together
prerequisites.note: graph: fraction-models (support), equivalent-fractions (disputed). No mandatory prerequisite is recorded; 'fraction as a count of unit pieces' is the real prerequisite.

concept: 3/8 means 3 pieces, each 1/8 of the whole. 2/8 means 2 more pieces of the same size.
Adding counts the pieces: 3 + 2 = 5 pieces, still eighths. The size of a piece does not change, so the bottom number stays 8.

hints: What size is each piece in these fractions?

Add the top numbers; the pieces are still 9ths.

alternativeExplanation.title: Units that do not change
text: 3 eighths + 2 eighths = 5 eighths: 'eighths' is the unit, like 'apples'.
